messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt for release/2026-04-01 paused: ci-staging pipeline failed during artifact fetch (cache restore checksum mismatch). Holding auto-promo. https://ci.internal/runs/13001

sam: which package?

deploy-bot: package: redwood_utils-0.9.8-py3-none-any.whl expected=3a7b... actual=0f4c...

anya: can you paste the tail of the fetch log?

sam: log snippet:
```
GET /cache/mirror/redwood_utils-0.9.8.whl 200
stream copy failed: checksum mismatch
expected=3a7b1d... actual=0f4c9e...
storage returned truncated object
```

infra-bot: mirror-sync job for region-us-west reported multipart finalize errors at 03:12:08 UTC for prefix redwood_utils/0.9.8

sre-lee: likely replication/truncate. Two options: 1) reupload mirrors now then retry promo (risk: may not finish within change window) 2) pin to last-good digest and promote, then rebuild later. What's our change window left?

anya: 25 minutes. I'd pick pin+promote. Customers will notice less if we keep schedule.

sam: found last-good digest in metadata: s3://prod-mirror/redwood_utils/0.9.8/sha256.txt -> 3a7b1d55

sre-lee: if pinning, add rollback note and file incident INC-2026-172. Also run a quick wheel-inspect to ensure contents match source tree hash.

sam: running dry-run promote:
```bash
deploybot promote --release release/2026-04-01 --artifact redwood_utils==0.9.8 --digest 3a7b1d55 --force-pin --dry-run
```

sam: dry-run output: OK. No schema issues. Proceeding with real promote.

deploy-bot: Promote accepted: release pinned to digest 3a7b1d55. Auto-promo resumed. Promo completes.

anya: created incident INC-2026-172, assigned to infra-blobstore team. Release notes updated: "redwood_utils 0.9.8 pinned to last-good artifact digest due to cache restore checksum mismatch; rebuild+re-upload scheduled."

sre-lee: marking release thread resolved. Incident remains open for RCA and uploader fix.
